title: Loler's Gems
description: Adds mob gems that have certain abilities and/or perks! (WIP)
body:
**Loler's Gems** adds gems infused with a mob's essence. These gems grant their users abilities and/or perks.

  ![Gems showcase](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/412a97bceab4e0c8185a4e8a6bcf1d8aee26391c.png)

<big>**_WARNING: THIS MOD IS STILL EARLY IN DEVELOPMENT AND IS BUGGY_**</big>

## **Gem Abilities/Perks**

Each gem has either a perk or an ability.
An example of a gem with an ability is the blaze gem, that when used, spews out fire like a flame thrower!

![Blaze Gem's ability being used on a village](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/123dd00a43c712a0a53faea31298c90e97b435d9.gif)

An example of a gem with a perk is the cod gem, that when in your inventory, you passively get saturation when underwater!

![Cod gem description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a950c9590ea767bac8a20e409521ddb4ab5d1426.png)


## **How to Make Gems**

You have to get the mob drops of your desired mob and put it in the gem infuser surrounding a gem base.

(Ex. Allay Gem)

![Allay recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/36bed48a04bfc48a2db6a6af8af67a40ce0446c9.png)


## **HOW TO MAKE A GEM BASE**

Put a diamond in the center of the crafting table, and then surround it with 4 quartz.

![Gem Base Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6aeacce7788809bc7356d4609d15961c12915ff4.png)



This mod also has JEI compat.
